news.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Abivax at Buy With $155 Price Target
news.summary: Goldman Sachs analyst Rajan Sharma started coverage of Abivax ADRs with a Buy rating and a $155 price target, calling obefazimod a potential 'multiblockbuster' with a de-risked, biologic-like efficacy profile in ulcerative colitis. Goldman models roughly EUR4bn in peak UC sales plus EUR3.5bn of further peak-sales potential in Crohn's disease, and the note helped push the ADR to a session high near $122 (about EUR105 in Paris) ahead of the September 21 earnings date.

news.headline: STAT: The Drugmaker Abivax Has Still Not Been Acquired. What's Going On?
news.summary: STAT's Adam Feuerstein examined why, nine months into a record biotech M&A year in which a roughly $20bn takeout of Abivax was widely treated as imminent, no deal has materialized, to the visible frustration of the shareholder base. The piece frames the delay as timing and process rather than a broken thesis, noting obefazimod's blockbuster commercial potential in ulcerative colitis remains intact.

news.headline: Abivax Named Among Three Top Immunology Takeover Targets in PharmaVoice Dealmaking Analysis
news.summary: PharmaVoice profiled Abivax alongside Spyre Therapeutics and MoonLake Immunotherapeutics as one of immunology's most talked-about M&A candidates, citing the ABTECT maintenance data (37% clinical remission and 48% endoscopic improvement at Week 44 among induction non-responders on 50 mg) and a roughly $25bn addressable IBD market by 2030. It notes CEO Marc de Garidel dismissed earlier 2026 Eli Lilly acquisition rumors as noise, and that the $920m July offering funds the company into 2029, reducing the urgency for a near-term sale.

news.headline: ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Review: Obefazimod Sustains Week-44 Remission With No Dose-Dependent Malignancy Signal
news.summary: A clinical review of the Phase 3 ABTECT Part 2 maintenance package confirmed that 37.2% of induction non-responders reached clinical remission and 34.5% endoscopic remission at Week 44 on continued 50 mg obefazimod, and that dose escalation to 50 mg recaptured clinical remission in 45.5% of patients who had relapsed in Part 1. Crucially for the June malignancy overhang, the expanded exposure showed malignancy and non-melanoma skin cancer rates consistent with UC background rates and no apparent dose-dependent signal.

news.headline: TCG Crossover and Chen Yu Report 7.0% Stake in Abivax After the July Offering
news.summary: Healthcare crossover investor TCG Crossover (Funds I and II, via managing partner Chen Yu) disclosed beneficial ownership of 6,007,834 ADSs, or 7.0% of Abivax, based on 86.09 million shares outstanding after the July 2, 2026 offering. It confirms that a dedicated biotech specialist held on through the large equity raise rather than selling into strength.

news.headline: Invus Entities Disclose 6.0% Beneficial Stake in Abivax
news.summary: Long-standing shareholder Invus (together with the Avicenna Fund) reported 4,825,759 ordinary shares and ADSs, equal to 6.0% of Abivax as of June 30, 2026. Alongside the TCG filing it rounds out a picture of a stable, concentrated institutional register ahead of the NDA filing.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax has this date fixed in its published financial calendar, now under a week out (report due after the September 21 close). The report will show the first post-raise balance sheet (cash was EUR 491.6m at March 31, 2026 before the $920m July offering, with runway now guided into 2029) and the step-up in R&D and pre-launch commercial spend; consensus points to a roughly $1.08 loss per share. Expect a business update on NDA preparation, EMA filing timing and the U.S. commercial build-out alongside the numbers, and the first chance since the September 10 Goldman Sachs Buy initiation for management to address the M&A question directly.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance dataset at an autumn gastroenterology congress (UEG Week / ACG)
catalysts.detail: Abivax presented two ABTECT induction late-breakers at UEG Week in Berlin in October 2025 and has a consistent pattern of taking full datasets to autumn congresses. A detailed public presentation of the Week-44 maintenance efficacy and, above all, the complete malignancy and safety database (already previewed via the August ABTECT Part 2 review) would be the cleanest way to fully retire the June cancer-signal overhang. No venue, abstract acceptance or presentation date for a 2026 autumn congress has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction data, the 44-week maintenance readout, the Part 2 refractory-patient dataset and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026. This is the single biggest near-term de-risking event and the gate that starts the FDA review clock. Management has reiterated the timeline at every update this year, and Goldman Sachs' September 10 Buy initiation explicitly underwrites this filing schedule.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists Q3 2026 results for December 14, 2026. By then the FDA submission should either have happened or be days away, so the release is the natural venue for confirming the NDA filing and giving first guidance on review type and expected PDUFA timing. It also lands roughly three months before the March-2027 option expiry, making it the last scheduled financial update inside the option's life.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe in the second half of 2026, contingent on the (now positive) 44-week maintenance data. Recent communication has emphasised the Q4 2026 FDA filing without restating a precise EMA date, so exact MAA timing remains unconfirmed and could slip into H1 2027. A European filing would open the second-largest UC market and is a lower-drama but real value step; the September 21 H1 report is the likely place for an update.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027 (first patient enrolled October 2024). Management has explicitly pushed this from an earlier late-2026 expectation. A positive readout opens a second large indication for the miR-124 mechanism - Goldman Sachs now models roughly EUR3.5bn of added peak-sales potential from it - and is the main pipeline diversification event, but it likely lands near or just after the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision and U.S. launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, i.e. in H2 2027, after the March-2027 call expiry. No PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted. The commercial organisation being hired since July 2026 is being built against this window, making it the ultimate approval and revenue catalyst for the equity.

pulse: Abivax has moved back into the news after a quiet late-August lull, with the ADR trading in a roughly $115-$128 band this week - still well below its $148.83 52-week high - after Goldman Sachs initiated coverage on September 10 at Buy with a $155 target, modeling a 'multiblockbuster' EUR4bn UC plus EUR3.5bn Crohn's peak-sales opportunity for obefazimod. That call reinforced rather than resolved the dominant narrative: the September 3 STAT piece asking why a company widely expected to be acquired for around $20bn remains independent nine months into a record M&A year, a question sharpened by the $920m July equity raise that funds a solo U.S. launch into 2029 and removes seller urgency, even as PharmaVoice still lists Abivax among the sector's top takeover candidates. Fundamentally the thesis stays de-risked - ABTECT induction plus Week-44 maintenance data remain strong and the Part 2 safety database put malignancy rates in line with UC background - with the September 21 H1 2026 results the next scheduled catalyst, giving the first post-raise balance sheet and an update on the late-Q4 2026 FDA NDA filing and any M&A resolution.
